approaches.title: Flood-fill boundary-connected water
approaches.summary: Flood-fill from the grid’s boundary to mark all water connected to the edge. Then scan the interior and count each remaining water component, marking it during traversal.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses an iterative stack flood fill to mark boundary-connected water, then counts and marks each remaining interior component.

revisions.commitBody:
- changing to water before adding to stack prevents visiting cell more
than once
- simplify neighbour visiting with a loop and options
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps the same flood-fill strategy, extracting it into a helper and marking cells when pushed to avoid duplicate visits. Simplifies neighbor checks with direction offsets.
